entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, and ai-led-session-workflow.md

Added SocialSecurityNumber (string?, maxLength 11) to Customer.cs; updated CustomerConfiguration.cs; added well-known test SSN to SeedData.GetCustomers() for customer 0; added EnsureAcmeCoffeeSchemaAsync to DatabaseInitializer for schema drift on existing databases
Created IFieldMaskService and FieldMaskService with {last4}, {firstChar}, unknown-token-literal, and null-safety rules; registered as AddSingleton in ServiceCollectionExtensions
Created FieldMaskServiceTests.cs with 9 unit tests covering SSN format, null/short input, firstChar, unknown token, multi-token, empty format, null non-empty output invariant

Injected IFieldMaskService into RestrictedFormField.razor; added Value (string?) parameter; replaced hardcoded '********' with FieldMaskService.RenderMasked(_resolved.MaskFormat, Value); added IFieldMaskService injection to RestrictedGridColumn.razor

Updated existing DefaultMask_NoExemption test to expect XXX-XX-**** (null Value); added DefaultMask_WithStoredValue_RendersTokenSubstitutedMask asserting XXX-XX-6789 for SSN 123-45-6789; registered IFieldMaskService in BunitTestContext.cs

dotnet build: 0 errors, 184 warnings (pre-existing obsolete [Obsolete] warnings). dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName!~Playwright: Passed 289 Dabbler.Security.Tests, 186 Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests, 27 AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests, 123 AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests, 33 Dabbler.Components.Tests, 16 Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests. Zero failures.
Cross-provider verification via session-verification. Model=opus. Cost=$0.5027

Fixed Minor: changed RenderMasked signature to string? maskFormat in IFieldMaskService and FieldMaskService. Added explanatory comment to RestrictedGridColumn.razor inject. Build + tests rerun: all pass.
Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, and ai-led-session-workflow.md
Created AppSensitiveAccessLog entity + SensitiveAccessEventKind enum in src/Libs/Dabbler.Security/Models/AppSensitiveAccessLog.cs (per spec). ValidFrom/ValidTo are shadow properties (EF requirement).

Added ConfigureAppSensitiveAccessLog to ModelBuilderExtensions.cs (followed existing convention rather than creating Configuration/AppSensitiveAccessLogConfiguration.cs because the Configuration/ folder is DTO-only). Generated migration 20260427154324_AddAppSensitiveAccessLog with temporal table syntax: history schema=history, history table=AppSensitiveAccessLogHistory. Indexes: (UserId, Timestamp desc), (EntityKey, ColumnKey, Timestamp desc), (CorrelationId).

Created IRenderCorrelationScope (Session 2 placeholder; full impl in Session 3) + RenderCorrelationScope. Created ISensitiveAccessAuditor with five methods: AuditRoleSwitchAsync, AuditExemptionGrantedAsync, AuditExemptionExpiredAsync, AuditFieldUnmaskedReadAsync, AuditAsync. SensitiveAccessAuditor uses IDbContextFactory for safe concurrent calls. Audit failures are logged but never bubble (best-effort per spec Risk Notes).

Created AuditingRoleSwitcher wrapping SessionRoleSwitcher; DI now registers SessionRoleSwitcher concrete + AuditingRoleSwitcher as IRoleSwitcher. SwitchToRole emits switch event; ClearSwitch captures pre-clear role then emits revert event. Both emissions are fire-and-forget so calling components do not pay an EF round-trip.

Hooked ExemptionGranted in MaskExemptionsSubTab.AddAsync (details=grant) and RenewAsync (details=renew). Granter principal captured at OnInitializedAsync; granter user id parsed to int when claim is numeric.

RestrictionBinder ResolveAsync now scans configuration.MaskExemptions for matching expired rows and emits ExemptionExpired audit via injected ISensitiveAccessAuditor. Per-scope HashSet of (entity|column|target|grantedTicks|expiryTicks) ensures emission once per exemption per circuit.

Added SensitiveAccessAuditIntegrationTests in Dabbler.Security.Tests/Integration covering RoleSwitch (auditor + decorator), ExemptionGranted, ExemptionExpired (auditor direct). Added RestrictionBinderExpiredAuditTests in Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests/Components/Restriction covering binder per-scope dedupe and active-exemption negative case. NOTE: Spec named tests/Dabbler.Security.IntegrationTests/ — placed in existing tests/Dabbler.Security.Tests/Integration/ folder per established convention.

dotnet build: 0 errors. dotnet test (excl Playwright): all green. Dabbler.Components.Tests 33, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests 16, Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Tests 188 (added 2 binder tests; updated BunitTestContext.cs to register NullSensitiveAccessAuditor since MaskExemptionsSubTab now injects ISensitiveAccessAuditor), AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests 27, Dabbler.Security.Tests 293 (added 4 integration tests), AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Tests 123. Total 680 passed.
